text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out and about with
Gold
Ship...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Look at that clear box over there! There
are tons
of Umamusume trapped in it!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп points toward a claw machine
filled
with Umamusume plushies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Who would do such a thing?! Hang on,
everyone!
Help is on the way!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Голд Шипп reassures the plushies behind
the glass.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're not the type that would
abandon all
these poor Umamusume, are
you?
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Good! Go in there and show us your
stuff! I'm
ready to witness the greatest
rescue operation of
the century!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
